title: SynKrown Games Hub
author: syn_krown
selftext:
I have been programming for about 20 years, never completed anything. Many unfinished projects.

Since utilizing AI to help with road blocks and speed up my development process, I have quite a few projects that are in a state that I am happy for others to use, and maybe get feedback on.

I present to you all my portfolio, SynKrown Games HUB.

I took inspiration from apps like Steam, even has a user profile with an XP leveling system and daily quests.

Everything uses IndexedDB(the browser storage) so I dont have to worry about server side stuff. And it helps that none of the user data leaves their browser.

All games and apps are free to use, and very useful.

I figured posting here was a good idea cause I am being transparent that I code with AI at my side and at least this sub will likely appreciate the work that has been put in. 

https://hub.synkrown.workers.dev
